note: Decision registry for the Claude Code setup of every consumer. Mirrors hermes/tools.json for the other harness. claude/apply_claude.py reads it; claude/README.md is the prose. One standard for every repo: user-scope install, no per-repo variation. Describe only; never put a path, account or secret here.

tools.install_hint: brew install rtk, then: rtk init -g --auto-patch (adds a PreToolUse hook to the user settings).
tools.reason: Shell-output filter. Same decision as the Hermes entry; Claude Code needs its own hook. Never-rewrite list applies (configurations.md section 11).

tools.install_hint: claude plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode; claude plugin install context-mode@context-mode
tools.reason: Sandboxes large tool output and keeps session state across compaction; complements rtk. Licence is Elastic 2.0, not OSI open source: consumers that redistribute must review it first (claude/README.md section 3).

tools.install_hint: npm install -g codebase-memory-mcp; codebase-memory-mcp install -y; codebase-memory-mcp config set auto_index true
tools.reason: The one code-graph standard: user scope, so every repo gets it with no per-repo file, indexed automatically. Its install adds hooks that steer the agent to the graph, which MCP-only tools lack.
Overlaps the code graph (a second set of tool schemas loaded every session) and its only independent measurement is one repo with an unverified vendor claim. Revisit if a paired benchmark appears.

tools.install_hint: Needs the caveman-compress skill, Python 3.10+ and the claude CLI. Read its scripts once before the first run.
tools.reason: Memory files load every session, so a one-time 10-30 percent cut repeats forever. Mandatory for the user-level memory file; a backup is kept out of tree and a failed validation leaves the file untouched.

tools.install_hint: Move the literal token into the OS keychain and point the server at a headersHelper script that prints the header JSON, or use an environment variable reference. Never leave a literal token in the user config.
tools.reason: A bearer token written into the user config is readable by every process and is copied by backups. Checked nightly; a finding is reported as MISSING and never auto-rewritten.

tools.install_hint: Remove unused connectors in the Claude account settings (web UI); the CLI cannot remove them.
tools.reason: Each connected claude.ai connector adds its tool schemas to every session. Keep only the ones in regular use; list the keepers in the consumer's own notes, not here.
